title: Chapter 237 The Allied Forces' Counterattack
content:
Chapter 237 The Allied Forces' Counterattack

Behind the Qin army, Wang Jian, who was surrounded and guarded by 30,000 elite Qin soldiers, watched the Qin army suddenly change from an easy victory to a steady retreat. He could only support the battlefield defense line with all his strength. Surprised and angry face.

"What's going on, did the Allied Forces of the Three Kingdoms on the opposite side take the wrong medicine? Why did they suddenly become so violent? The low morale suddenly rose, who can tell me why? And my Daqin warriors? When did they become so incompetent? , was driven away by a group of bereaved dogs!" Wang Jian's face was flushed, and he scolded the lieutenant beside him.

"Well, this last general doesn't know that the coalition army is indeed acting abnormally. It will be completed within time, but only a moment!" The deputy general hastily reached out his hand to wipe the unstoppable sweat from his forehead, and explained to Wang Jian who was furious in front of him.

He could understand how crazy the huge emotional contrast and reality change would make a person when he saw the victory fly away, and in turn, it turned out to be a big defeat.

Now if he touches Wang Jian's brow, accepts his anger, and resists the thunder, then his fate will never be better.

"You, hum!" Looking at the terrified lieutenant beside him, Wang Jian snorted coldly and stopped embarrassing him.

After all, he is also a generation of military gods, so he naturally understands that this lieutenant general cannot be blamed for things, and he will not blame him. He still has this kind of courage, otherwise he would not be the commander-in-chief of the 450,000 army in the central part of Qin State, and he was also defeated by King Qin. political trust.

However, suppressing the anger in his heart, the current situation still needs to be resolved, Wang Jian thought for a while, and then gave an order.

"Immediately pass the order to me, and stand in line to catch up with me, and drive all the deserters back to the battlefield. Anyone who dares to disobey the order will be killed on the spot!"

The deputy general in front of him, who was panicking and restless, had a tinge of joy on his face when he heard the words of his chief general. He knew that his calamity was over, so he quickly responded.

"Yes, yes, the general will go down and order that all these fleeing soldiers must be driven back to the battlefield!" The lieutenant quickly replied a few times, then turned and left, his steps were surprisingly fast, as if there was something terrifying behind him .

On the battlefield, the retreating Qin army was continuously attacked by the coalition forces attached behind them, and the barely maintained front was also in jeopardy. Those Qin troops were frightened by the desperate and crazy fighting style of the coalition forces.

Although Qin Jun is also an elite, he is extremely proficient in fighting, and has his own unique skills in killing people, which can be said to have come out of a sea of corpses and blood.

But in the face of these, they don't care about life and death at all, they don't even care about pain, and they don't care about the exhausted allied forces. Everything that the Qin army has experienced is nothing.

So at the beginning, the Qin army was able to persevere, barely fighting the coalition forces that had just boosted their morale, but then the Qin army couldn't stand the kind of fighting with life and regardless of life and death, and completely collapsed.

After all, the composition of the Qin army was too complex, including the survivors of the six countries, the strong soldiers recruited by force, the defeated troops from various places, the local guards, and the elite sent by Chongguang.

These people from all over Qin State formed the huge army of Qin State today.

Before, they had an advantage in numbers, and because of the skin of Qin, they had an advantage in morale. That's why it has been able to fight against the coalition forces, and now the number of people fighting is more than twice that of the coalition forces.

All of this is due to the aura of Qin State and the morale driven by the bravery of those elite Qin State regular troops, so they have such an advantage.

But now, the soldiers of the coalition forces are no longer afraid of death, and they are not afraid of death when fighting. Then those miscellaneous troops in Qin who were still dying were naturally afraid. Even with the lead of those regular troops, the dead are still terrifying after all.

Therefore, Qin's defeat was like a snowball. Starting from those miscellaneous troops, a general trend gradually formed. When they knew it was unstoppable, they also wrapped up the regular troops and fled back.

Up to now, every soldier in the state of Qin is panic-stricken, and they all want to escape from the battlefield, escape from this terrible place, hide in a safe place, and hide until the end of this war.

In the eyes of those soldiers, the coalition forces chasing from the rear no longer belonged to the category of human beings. They were not afraid of death, pain, or tiredness. All they wanted was to kill themselves, and they would do whatever they could to do so.

This kind of behavior is beyond their understanding, just like the evil spirits crawling out of hell, they only exist for killing.

Thoughts of fear were pervasive, gradually spreading to all the troops of the Qin army, and it was difficult to contain them. Even those elite Qin troops were affected, and their morale began to decline.

On the opposite side of the Qin army, a cavalry force was chasing after them, following closely the footsteps of the Qin army's deserters, chasing after them.

The commander of this cavalry, the current general of South Korea, is also the supreme commander of the more than 8,000 remaining South Korean soldiers on this battlefield. At this moment, he is leading his 1,000 personal guard cavalry, the most elite troops in South Korea, to pursue the Qin army in front of him.

As the most powerful military member in South Korea, Ji Wuye's influence in South Korea is unimaginable. Naturally, as his personal guard, he is also the top existence in South Korea.

These 1,000 cavalry are all third-rate masters with internal strength, and among the third-rate masters, because they are from the army, they are very familiar with killing techniques, and they often face off against opponents of the same level, and they can win.

Such an elite army is all loyal to Ji Wuye. In their eyes, May's order is more important than Hanwang's order, and it is the highest priority.

And Ji Wuye was able to maintain his powerful position in South Korea by relying on this army, and let his assassination organization, Yemu, bow down and profess his vassal, and dare not make mistakes.

Usually, Ji Wuye would hide this kind of army and confess it as a treasure, for fear of losing some of it and shaking his own power.

Now they are willing to bring them to this extremely dangerous battlefield, where hundreds of thousands of people have been buried, it is really unexpected.

But in Ji Wuye's heart, there are his thoughts.

Looking at South Korea, this ship has been broken, disabled, and sunk. And as the general of South Korea, it is difficult to guarantee his authority. I don't know when he will follow the wrecked ship of South Korea and sink to the bottom of the sea with FAW, without seeing the light of day.
